assumptions: remaining basis chosen = ledger (remaining_basis=ledger:baseline-2), not the 4,320 cap: LEDGER-GRID-BASELINE-2.json is the frozen pre-grid baseline (label pre_grid_era_b, frozen 19:04:18Z) and REQUEST-LEDGER.json agrees at 3,192, so both records witness one number; the cap is not a remaining figure and would have over-stated the pool by 1,128. Two records that disagree is a refusal (test_disagreeing_ledger_records_are_a_refusal) rather than a silent choice.

3,219 was NOT adopted as a third basis: it is the pre-rebuild total the launcher happened to hold, and the 27-request gap it implies is exactly what LEDGER-REBUILD-27 settled. Keeping it would have re-created the defect the card is about.

The pin is read at import with a signed-off expectation (generation+digest), rather than either hardcoding the digest or accepting whatever the record says: the first is the drift that broke the launch, the second cannot fail when a new generation freezes. A refusal is deferred from import to the gates so the module stays importable for the tests that prove the refusal; main() calls pinned_digest() and grid_record() before building any plan, so no cell can start.

The cell plan is derived from shape.arms in the record, but the record's shape is required to equal the launcher's SHAPE_EXPECTATION (6/6/2/2). I did not let the record alone define the plan: a record edited to 3/3/2/2 would then silently relaunch the 10-cell shape, which is the CELLS regression this card is asked to make impossible.

The price line is printed in BOTH the dry run and the live start (before any cell), and carries price_approved=false from price.spend_status, so the printed line cannot be mistaken for approved spend.

The price is quoted as the record's total (1,056 = 768 turns x 1.374532, the tools-off historical factor) without smoothing it toward the tools-on ceiling of 1,152 or the G1 basis of 1,536 -- GRID-PARAMS.json records all three as fitting the 4,320 cap and the launcher prints the one the record calls total.

Two test-only import hooks were added (RUN_A_STAR_PIN, RUN_A_STAR_GRID) so the /tmp-record proofs run without editing the real measure/ files; they default to the real records and are named in docs/LAUNCHER-WIRING.md.

The test file lives at experiments/ptr-engine/tests/test_launcher_pin_and_cells.py exactly as the card declares, while the two existing launcher suites live in /home/zer0null/reserach extarctor/tests/. Both were run; the new suite is invoked by absolute path so it runs from any cwd.
